subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about funded accounts for {Brand}. One angle I did not stress: the deposit line is where fraud concentrates, with SentiLink reading synthetic fraud at 0.58 percent and identity theft at 5.61 percent across the second half of 2025 (SentiLink 2025). With consumer banking acquisition near $258 per customer (First Page Sage 2024), an unscreened funded-account line quietly carries synthetic and multi-accounted opens. We screen the deposit event and hold paid opens against a holdout so they read as incremental. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: deposit-line fraud concentration (SentiLink 2H 2025) + consumer banking CAC ~$258 band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN fintech neobank: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior outreach in first sentence; fresh angle = deposit-line fraud concentration (SentiLink synthetic 0.58% / identity theft 5.61% 2H 2025) plus REAL consumer-banking CAC band ~$258 (First Page Sage 2024), both verified sources carried from the parent with URLs in enrichment_sources; no peer brand named this stage; MobUpps holdout incrementality referenced with no figure; no MobUpps figure this stage; exactly one question mark; native US English; no sign-off; no em dash; no X-not-Y.
